notes: Exact ADAM Audio T7V official product page: two-way active nearfield monitor with one 7-inch polypropylene woofer and one U-ART tweeter (two transducers). The manufacturer specifies 39 Hz–25 kHz frequency response at -6 dB and a 70 W total RMS amplifier rating (50 W woofer + 20 W tweeter), recorded only as amplifier_output, not passive-speaker power handling. Maximum SPL of at least 110 dB per pair at 1 m is not sensitivity. Sensitivity, driver impedance, free-air resonant frequency and voice-coil size are not published here. The response bounds retain their stated -6 dB context; no response points or directivity dataset is imported. Source: https://www.adam-audio.com/en/t-series/t7v/.
